description: This file implements the 'html_entity_decode' function, which decodes HTML entities into their corresponding characters. It includes licensing information, a list of credited authors, and references to online resources. The function utilizes a translation table obtained from 'get_html_translation_table' and handles specific entity conversions.

methods.name: html_entity_decode(string,quote_style)
methods.description: Decodes HTML entities in a given string into their corresponding characters, with support for different quote styles.
